court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Alpine
case_search_note: Court says it does not currently offer online access to court records via a public portal, and there is no public access terminal at the courthouse; all searches/copy requests are done by court staff (use the Records Requests page). Automatic record-relief copies are given only at the counter with photo ID — not mailed, faxed or emailed.

courthouses.name: Alpine County Superior Court (Markleeville)
courthouses.note: Only courthouse in the county. Criminal calendar is Mondays at 1:30 p.m. for cases filed by the DA; it does not run on court holidays or jury-trial weeks — call the clerk to confirm. Felony arraignments generally require in-person appearance; misdemeanor defendants may sometimes appear remotely. Mailing: P.O. Box 518, Markleeville, CA 96120. Fax (530) 694-2119. Divisions listed: criminal, traffic, civil, family, juvenile, probate, appeals.

public_defenders.name: Law Office of Kyle Neddenriep (Alpine County contract criminal defense)
public_defenders.note: Alpine County has no public defender office; the court's Criminal page says the county is currently contracted with this law office for criminal defense of people who cannot afford a lawyer. Ask the judge for appointed counsel at your first appearance.

jails.name: El Dorado County Jail — Placerville (contract housing)
jails.phone_note: Number from El Dorado Sheriff visiting page. Alpine County has NO jail; Alpine Sheriff says jail services are contracted to El Dorado and Calaveras Counties.
jails.note: Capacity 303 inmates + 8 outpatient medical beds per El Dorado Sheriff Custody page. In-person visits listed daily 8–11 a.m. & 1–4 p.m., plus Mon–Thu 7–10 p.m.; video visits via NCIC (videovisit.ncic.com). El Dorado inmate list: https://eldoradosheriff.citizenrims.com/incarcerated-people
